description: a broad strong man holy demon hunter with short dark hair and a stern scarred face, gleaming silver plate armour with golden sun engravings, a long white tabard with a golden sun, a short white cape with gold trim, a horned demon skull hanging at the belt, one single huge greatsword with glowing golden runes held in his right hand at his side with the blade pointing down, only one sword, the left hand empty, seen from the side in strict profile: the face, chest, hips and feet all turned fully to the right, only one eye visible, never towards the viewer, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
